effect_description_eng: {Hand} [Main] If you have a Tamer with [Reina Sakuya] in its name, by placing 1 [Wolvermon] from your trash as any of your [Pristimon]'s bottom digivolution card, that Digimon digivolves into this card, ignoring level. [On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, give 1 of their Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When attack targets change, if this Digimon has the [Glowing Dawn] trait, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, trash your opponent's top security card.
